purpose: Reusable closing-beat styles for the final 30 seconds, to avoid every episode ending identically. Pairs with STORY.md's fixed 5-beat structure — this varies the FEEL of the fixed 'Closing' beat, not its length.

endings.description: Episode closes with the character(s) saying the relevant dua together, calm and warm.
endings.best_for: episodes centered on a specific dua

endings.description: A gentle direct-to-camera question inviting the viewer to think of their own similar moment.
endings.best_for: moral/values episodes without a specific dua

endings.description: Ends on a quiet family scene (hug, shared smile) rather than dialogue.
A small, kind surprise resolves the episode (e.g. the lost toy turns up, a friend appears).
Episode closes with the short song from lyrics_and_song.md.
endings.best_for: episodes with a strong sing-along moment

metadata.rule: Never repeat the same ending_id in two consecutive episodes — check world_state.json episode_chronology.
